t: What was said by people told to be afraid
a: فَٱنقَلَبُوا۟ بِنِعْمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ لَّمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سُوٓءٌ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ رِضْوَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَظِيمٍ
p: Fa-nqalabū bi-niʿmatin mina-llāhi wa faḍlin lam yamsas'hum sū'un wa-ttabaʿū riḍwāna-llāh…
m: So they returned with favor from Allāh and bounty, no harm having touched them. And they pursued the pleasure of Allāh, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
